easyPrerequisites: You control a copy or clone of Derevi that is legendary and has Derevi's name.
notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may untap any permanent(s) using Derevi's trigger. The card you use to clone / copy Derevi must not bypass the legend rule. The copy must be legendary and have Derevi's name for the legend rule to take effect appropriately.
description:
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}{U}.
Activate Derevi by paying {1}{G}{W}{U}, putting it onto the battlefield from the command zone.
Put Derevi into your graveyard due to the legend rule, and then choose to return Derevi to the command zone.
Derevi's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers twice due to Roaming Throne.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Bloom Tender.
Holding priority, activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}{U}.
Resolve the second Derevi trigger, untapping Bloom Tender.
Repeat.
